summary: Lifezone Metals Ltd filed a corrected prospectus supplement on Form 424B5 for a registered direct offering of 5,700,000 ordinary shares at $4.40 per share (a ~19.7% discount to the $5.48 last sale on April 21, 2026) to institutional investors, aiming to raise $25.08M gross ($23.58M net after 6% placement agent fees to Roth Capital Partners). The correction adjusts net tangible book value from an error to (~$69.0M, or ($0.82)/share) and fixes dilution per share to $4.91. Closing is expected April 23, 2026. This is a routine equity capital raise, not a special situation.
